title: Standards-Guided and Dependency-Aware Code-Level Documentation Generation
title_zh: 标准引导且依赖感知的代码级文档生成

paragraphs.en: Automatically generating high-quality documentation for software repositories remains challenging because existing approaches largely treat documentation as an unconstrained text generation problem. As a result, they often lack explicit quality specifications, depend heavily on long-context prompts over raw code, and provide limited support for reproducible evaluation. We argue that code-level documentation generation should instead be formulated as a standards-guided software engineering task , in which documentation is generated and assessed against explicit, reusable quality requirements derived from authoritative documentation standards. In this paper, code documentation refers to natural-language descriptions of repository functions and classes, organized by source-code path.
paragraphs.zh: 为软件仓库自动生成高质量文档仍然极具挑战性，因为现有方法大多将文档视为一个无约束的文本生成问题。 因此，这些方法往往缺乏明确的质量规范，严重依赖对原始代码的长上下文提示，并且对可复现评估的支持有限。 我们认为，代码级文档生成应当被重新表述为一项以标准为指导的软件工程任务，即依据从权威文档标准中提取的、明确且可复用的质量要求来生成和评估文档。 在本文中，代码文档指按源代码路径组织的、对仓库中函数与类的自然语言描述。

paragraphs.en: We present CodeDoc , a standards-guided and dependency-aware framework for code-level documentation generation. CodeDoc identifies dependencies between code entities using static call-graph and AST analysis. It then constructs dependency-aware structured prompts that combine local code context, repository paths, and documentation criteria derived from authoritative standards and style guides. We further introduce an interactive LLM-as-a-judge protocol that provides criterion-aligned feedback to optimize generated documentation, enabling targeted refinement based on fine-grained dimensions derived from formal and practice-oriented documentation standards. Experiments on ten open-source Python repositories show that CodeDoc produces higher-quality documentation than both RepoAgent and a long-context baseline under standards-aligned evaluation, with relative improvements of 11.6%–17.0% and 21.4%–29.6%, respectively, while consuming roughly an order of magnitude fewer tokens per documentation entity than the long-context baseline. A human evaluation study confirms substantial alignment between LLM-based and human judgments (Spearman’s ρ = 0.72 \rho=0.72 ), and the relative findings are preserved across different judge LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/ControllableModel/CodeDoc .

paragraphs.en: Throughout the software lifecycle, developers continuously interact with existing code artifacts [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] , especially during tasks such as feature extension [ 5 ] , bug fixing [ 6 ] , code review [ 7 ] , and system maintenance [ 8 ] . A growing body of empirical evidence shows that a substantial portion of developers’ effort is devoted to understanding existing code rather than writing new functionality [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] . In this context, high-quality code documentation plays a critical role in facilitating code comprehension, supporting collaboration, and improving the maintainability and evolution of software systems. However, maintaining documentation manually is labor-intensive and error-prone [ 12 , 13 ] . As software evolves, documentation often becomes incomplete, inconsistent, or outdated, reducing its usefulness and potentially harming overall software quality. These challenges have motivated increasing research interest in automatic code documentation generation, with the goal of reducing manual effort while improving the availability and quality of software documentation [ 14 , 15 , 16 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在整个软件生命周期中，开发者需要持续与既有代码工件打交道 [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 ] ，尤其是在功能扩展 [ 5 ] 、缺陷修复 [ 6 ] 、代码审查 [ 7 ] 和系统维护 [ 8 ] 等任务中。 越来越多的实证证据表明，开发者的相当一部分精力花在理解既有代码上，而非编写新功能 [ 9 , 10 , 11 ] 。 在此背景下，高质量的代码文档在促进代码理解、支持协作以及提升软件系统的可维护性和演化方面发挥着关键作用。 然而，人工维护文档既费力又容易出错 [ 12 , 13 ] 。 随着软件不断演化，文档常常变得不完整、不一致或过时，从而降低其实用性，并可能损害整体软件质量。 这些挑战促使人们对自动代码文档生成的研究兴趣日益增长，其目标是在减少人工投入的同时，提升软件文档的可用性和质量 [ 14 , 15 , 16 ] 。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 1 , following [ 17 ] , documentation in a code repository can be organized at different levels. Project-level documentation describes the repository as a whole, such as README, CONTRIBUTING, and LICENSE files. Architecture-level documentation explains higher-level design and interface information, such as architecture descriptions and API documents. In contrast, this work focuses on code-level documentation, which refers to natural-language descriptions attached to individual code entities, such as function and class descriptions and docstrings. Different from inline code comments, which are implementation-level annotations embedded in the code body that explain how or why particular statements work, code-level documentation describes an entity’s purpose, behavior, interface, and role within the repository, forming a self-contained description. Repository-level documentation can be constructed by organizing these entity-level descriptions according to the source code structure, but our study specifically targets generating documentation for a single code entity at a time.
paragraphs.zh: 如图1所示，遵循[17]，代码仓库中的文档可以在不同层级进行组织。 项目级文档描述仓库整体，例如README、CONTRIBUTING和LICENSE文件。 架构级文档解释更高层级的设计和接口信息，例如架构描述和API文档。 相比之下，本工作聚焦于代码级文档，它指附着在单个代码实体上的自然语言描述，例如函数和类描述以及文档字符串。 与内联代码注释不同——注释是嵌入代码体中解释特定语句如何工作或为何这样写的实现级标注——代码级文档描述一个实体的目的、行为、接口及其在仓库中的角色，构成一个自包含的描述。 仓库级文档可以按照源代码结构组织这些实体级描述来构建，但我们的研究专门针对一次为一个代码实体生成文档。

paragraphs.en: Existing research on automatic code documentation generation falls into three strains. Heuristic-based methods generate documentation through handcrafted templates, rules, or retrieval over similar fragments [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 ] . They are interpretable and controllable, but rely on manually designed heuristics or code-similarity assumptions and generalize poorly to large, evolving codebases, especially in repository-level settings with cross-file and cross-function dependencies. Neural model-based methods learn mappings from code to natural language using pretrained code models such as CodeNN [ 25 ] , CodeBERT [ 26 ] , and PLBART [ 27 ] , substantially improving semantic modeling, but most focus on function-level summarisation rather than repository-wide coverage. LLM-based methods leverage in-context learning and long-context capabilities of general-purpose LLMs to produce more fluent and adaptable documentation, and recent repository-level systems such as RepoAgent [ 16 ] and RepoSummary [ 14 ] explicitly incorporate directory structures, code dependencies, and feature-level organization to improve global coherence beyond isolated method-level summaries. Despite these advances, existing approaches still face several fundamental challenges: They lack explicit and verifiable documentation criteria, leaving the notion of what constitutes high-quality documentation largely implicit and inconsistent across tools and usage scenarios; They often incur high token costs because they rely on deep recursive analysis and redundant dependency inputs, which limit scalability and hinder practical deployment on large repositories. Their code understanding can become unstable when excessively long contexts are provided, as critical information may be diluted by irrelevant details, leading to inconsistent or inaccurate documentation generation. Their evaluation methods still rely heavily on human judgments and subjective assessments, which makes results harder to reproduce and limits objective comparison across methods.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的自动代码文档生成研究可分为三大方向。 基于启发式的方法通过手工设计的模板、规则或对相似片段的检索来生成文档 [ 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 ] 。 这类方法具有可解释性和可控性，但依赖人工设计的启发式规则或代码相似性假设，在大型且不断演化的代码库上泛化能力较差，尤其是在存在跨文件和跨函数依赖的仓库级场景中。 基于神经模型的方法利用预训练代码模型（如 CodeNN [ 25 ] 、CodeBERT [ 26 ] 和 PLBART [ 27 ] ）学习从代码到自然语言的映射，显著提升了语义建模能力，但大多数方法只关注函数级摘要，而非覆盖整个仓库。 基于大语言模型的方法利用通用大语言模型的上下文学习和长上下文能力，生成更流畅、更具适应性的文档；近期一些仓库级系统（如 RepoAgent [ 16 ] 和 RepoSummary [ 14 ] ）显式地结合目录结构、代码依赖和功能级组织，以提升全局连贯性，超越孤立的方法级摘要。 尽管取得了这些进展，现有方法仍面临若干根本性挑战：它们缺乏明确且可验证的文档标准，使得“何为高质量文档”这一概念在很大程度上仍是隐式的，且在不同工具和使用场景之间不一致；它们通常产生高昂的 token 开销，因为其依赖深度递归分析和冗余的依赖输入，这限制了可扩展性，阻碍了在大型仓库上的实际部署。 当提供的上下文过长时，它们的代码理解可能变得不稳定，因为关键信息可能被无关细节稀释，导致文档生成结果不一致或不准确。 它们的评估方法仍然严重依赖人工判断和主观评价，这使得结果难以复现，也限制了不同方法之间的客观比较。

paragraphs.en: To address the above challenges, we formulate automatic code documentation generation as a standards-guided and verifiable generation task, in which the content, structure, and scope of the generated documentation are explicitly constrained by well-defined documentation requirements derived from documentation standards. In this work, we propose CodeDoc , a standards-guided and dependency-aware framework for code-level documentation generation. We first extract documentation standards from authoritative sources, including ISO/IEC/IEEE standards and widely used style guides, and convert them into explicit criteria that define what to document and how to structure it. Guided by these criteria, CodeDoc generates accurate and structured documentation by combining standards grounding with static program analysis. It further incorporates dependency-aware context construction to capture relationships between code entities across the repository, and closes the loop with a criterion-aligned LLM judge whose feedback iteratively refines the generated documentation against the same standards. paragraphs.en: Software documentation can describe a repository at different levels, from project-level files such as READMEs to architecture-level documents and code-level descriptions. ISO/IEC/IEEE standards [ 28 ] treat source code as a distinct life-cycle artifact subject to inspection, analysis, verification, and validation. Following this source-code-level perspective, we define code-level documentation as natural-language descriptions attached to individual code entities, such as functions, methods, and classes. Typical examples include Python docstrings, Javadoc comments, and Doxygen documentation blocks, which are written alongside source code and can be extracted into API or reference documentation [ 29 , 30 , 31 ] . Code-level documentation generation therefore aims to automatically produce such entity-level descriptions from code, a task commonly studied as function or method documentation generation in prior work [ 32 , 26 ] . In this paper, we focus on generating documentation for a single code entity at a time, rather than producing project- or architecture-level documents.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present an automated framework for generating and evaluating code-level documentation by integrating static program analysis with large language models (LLMs). As shown in Figure 2 , the framework is organized into two phases. Phase (a) Offline Criteria Extraction ( Section III-A ) is performed once, ahead of any repository being processed, and turns authoritative documentation standards into an explicit, reusable criterion set 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} . Phase (b) Online Code Documentation Generation is the per-repository runtime pipeline; it consists of Stage 1 ( Section III-B ), which builds a dependency-aware structural representation from the source code, and Stage 2 ( Section III-C ), which combines that representation with 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} to produce, organise, and refine the per-entity documentation. paragraphs.en: Both stages of Phase (b) rely on an explicit set of documentation criteria 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} derived once, offline, from authoritative documentation standards. The criteria simultaneously serve two roles: they constrain what Stage 2 must produce (as part of the structured prompt), and they form the rubric under which the document judge inside Stage 2, as well as any external evaluator ( Section IV ), scores the generated artifacts. Making these criteria explicit, fine-grained, and standards-aligned is what distinguishes CodeDoc from prior repository-level documentation systems that rely on implicit, ad-hoc prompts.

paragraphs.en: Source standards: we draw criteria from two complementary references that together cover formal and practice-oriented documentation expectations. ISO/IEC/IEEE software documentation standards [ 33 ] provide a formal engineering rubric covering correctness, completeness, consistency, modular organisation, maintainability, accessibility, internationalisation, safety, and update discipline; we adopt them as a baseline against which “engineering-grade” documentation is assessed. The GitHub documentation style guide encodes the practice of widely used open-source documentation, including developer-facing readability, task-oriented organization, navigability, procedural clarity, and contributor usability; we adopt it to complement the formal ISO rubric with the developer-experience axis.
paragraphs.zh: 来源标准：我们从两个互补的参考中提取准则，它们共同覆盖了正式的与实践导向的文档要求。 ISO/IEC/IEEE 软件文档标准 [ 33 ] 提供了一套正式的工程准则，涵盖正确性、完整性、一致性、模块化组织、可维护性、可访问性、国际化、安全性以及更新纪律；我们将其作为基线，用以评估“工程级”文档。 GitHub 文档风格指南体现了广泛使用的开源文档实践，包括面向开发者的可读性、任务导向的组织方式、可导航性、流程清晰性以及对贡献者的可用性；我们采用它以开发者体验这一维度来补充正式的 ISO 准则。

paragraphs.en: Extraction pipeline: we operationalize the standards into machine-actionable criteria in two steps. (i) Candidate extraction. GPT-5-mini processes each source standard document and is prompted to identify distinct, assessable quality aspects, producing candidate items of the form (category, dimension, description, scoring guideline) where each dimension corresponds to one independently verifiable property. This step yields an over-complete set that may contain duplicates and ambiguous phrasings. (ii) Manual review and normalisation. We manually inspect the candidates, deduplicate semantically overlapping entries, and normalize the wording so that each dimension maps to a concrete, independently scorable aspect. The output is a fixed-schema rubric: each dimension carries a short name (used as the judge’s variable), a one-sentence definition (used in the prompt), and a 1–5 scoring anchor (used to calibrate the judge).
paragraphs.zh: 抽取流程：我们通过两个步骤将这些标准转化为机器可操作的评判准则。 (i) 候选项抽取。 GPT-5-mini 处理每份源标准文档，并被提示识别出相互独立、可评估的质量方面，从而生成形如（类别、维度、描述、评分指南）的候选项，其中每个维度对应一个可独立验证的属性。 这一步会产生一个超完备的集合，其中可能包含重复项和表述模糊的条目。 (ii) 人工审核与规范化。 我们人工检查这些候选项，对语义重叠的条目进行去重，并统一措辞，使每个维度都对应一个具体的、可独立打分的方面。 最终输出是一个固定模式的评分细则：每个维度都有一个简短名称（用作评判器的变量）、一句定义（用于提示词），以及一个 1–5 分的评分锚点（用于校准评判器）。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2 takes the refined representation 𝒞 ′ \mathcal{C}^{\prime} together with the criterion set 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} from Phase (a), and produces per-entity documentation through an iterative prompt-and-refine loop (see Figure 2 ). For each target entity the prompt engine selectively retrieves a small set of dependency-relevant entities from ℛ ′ \mathcal{R}^{\prime} —typically the direct callers and callees—rather than exposing the LLM to the entire repository. It then assembles a structured prompt that combines four blocks in a fixed order: (i) documentation criteria definitions drawn from 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} , (ii) target entity source code with its repository path, (iii) dependency-relevant entity source code with caller/callee annotations, and (iv) generation instructions specifying the expected output format. The LLM produces documentation that is anchored in the entity’s local implementation while remaining aware of its role within the broader dependency structure. The output is organised by source-code path so that each artifact remains traceable to its code entity.

paragraphs.en: This section evaluates CodeDoc along a deliberate progression: we first establish that our measuring instrument is sound, then use it to assess quality, and finally dissect the cost and mechanism behind the results. RQ1 asks whether the standards-derived, LLM-based evaluation is itself trustworthy—sensitive to quality degradation, aligned with human judges, and stable across judge families. RQ2 then uses this validated protocol to test whether CodeDoc improves documentation quality over baselines and whether the gain is broad-based. RQ3 finally asks at what token cost these gains come, which components drive them, and how reliable the static dependency recovery underpinning the method is. Each question builds on the previous: RQ2 relies on the rubric validated in RQ1, and RQ3 interprets the cost of the quality established in RQ2.
paragraphs.zh: 本节按照精心设计的递进结构评估 CodeDoc：我们首先验证测量工具本身是可靠的，然后用它来评估质量，最后剖析结果背后的成本与机制。 RQ1 探讨基于标准、由大语言模型驱动的评估本身是否可信——即其对质量退化是否敏感、与人类评审是否一致、以及在不同评审模型家族间是否稳定。 RQ2 随后使用这一经过验证的协议，检验 CodeDoc 是否比基线方法提升了文档质量，以及这一提升是否具有广泛性。 RQ3 最后探讨这些提升付出了多少 token 成本、由哪些组件驱动，以及支撑该方法的静态依赖恢复的可靠性如何。 每个问题都建立在前一个问题之上：RQ2 依赖于 RQ1 中验证的评分标准，而 RQ3 则解读 RQ2 中确立的质量背后的成本。

paragraphs.en: RQ2 (Documentation Quality): Does CodeDoc produce higher-quality documentation than existing baselines under the standards-aligned evaluation, and is the improvement broad-based across quality dimensions?
paragraphs.zh: RQ2（文档质量）：在与标准对齐的评估下，CodeDoc 生成的文档质量是否高于现有基线？这种提升是否广泛体现在各个质量维度上？

paragraphs.en: RQ3 (Cost, Components & Reliability): At what generation cost does CodeDoc achieve these gains, which of its design choices drive them, and how reliable is the static dependency recovery the method depends on?

paragraphs.en: LLM-based judge: Following recent work [ 34 , 35 ] , we use an LLM judge to score generated documentation against predefined criteria. For each dimension, the judge assigns a 1 1 – 5 5 score (higher is better) and is instructed to focus exclusively on the documentation artifact and the corresponding criterion. The repository-level score under a given standard is the mean of dimension-level scores. To examine whether the judge’s interaction style affects evaluation stability, we report results under two scoring strategies: single-round (S), where all dimensions are scored within a single-round conversation, and multi-round (M), where each dimension is scored in an independent interaction

paragraphs.en: RQ1.a – Criterion sensitivity (controlled masking). To answer whether the extracted criteria capture quality, we use a controlled-masking method: if the criteria genuinely capture quality, their scores should fall as quality is progressively removed. We therefore validate whether the extracted criteria respond sensibly to controlled quality degradation. Using official PyTorch 2.8 documentation files [ 36 ] , we select all files larger than 20 KB as high-quality references and randomly mask 20 % 20\% , 40 % 40\% , or 60 % 60\% of each file’s content to obtain four document groups (one clean, three progressively degraded). All groups are scored by the LLM judge under the multi-round strategy only (to isolate criterion sensitivity from intra-dialogue effects) under both ISO- and GitHub-based criteria.
paragraphs.zh: RQ1.a – 标准敏感性（受控掩蔽）。 为回答所提取的标准是否确实捕捉了质量，我们采用受控掩蔽方法：如果这些标准真正捕捉了质量，那么随着质量被逐步移除，其评分应当随之下降。 因此，我们验证所提取的标准能否对受控的质量退化作出合理响应。 使用官方 PyTorch 2.8 文档文件 [36]，我们选取所有大于 20 KB 的文件作为高质量参考，并随机掩蔽每个文件 20%、40% 或 60% 的内容，从而得到四个文档组（一个干净组，三个逐步退化组）。 所有组均仅由大语言模型评审在多轮策略下进行评分（以将标准敏感性与对话内效应隔离开来），并同时采用基于 ISO 和基于 GitHub 的标准。

The monotonic decline indicates that the extracted dimensions respond to controlled information loss rather than producing arbitrary scores. paragraphs.en: RQ1.b – Human alignment and cross-family judge robustness. We validate the LLM-based evaluation along two axes: alignment with human judges, and robustness across judge model families. We sample three repositories spanning different scales—Flask (small), NumPy (medium), and PyTorch (large)—and randomly select 15 functions per repository, yielding 45 documentation pairs (one from CodeDoc and one from RepoAgent per function). Three graduate students with two or more years of Python development experience score every artifact (blinded, randomised order) on a 1 1 – 5 5 scale across a representative subset of eight ISO dimensions. To assess robustness across judge families, we re-evaluate the same 45 pairs using Claude-3.5-Sonnet under an identical rubric.
paragraphs.zh: RQ1.b——人类一致性与跨家族裁判模型的稳健性。 我们从两个维度验证基于大语言模型的评估：与人类评判者的一致性，以及跨裁判模型家族的稳健性。 我们抽取三个不同规模的代码库——Flask（小型）、NumPy（中型）和 PyTorch（大型）——并从每个代码库中随机选取 15 个函数，共得到 45 对文档（每个函数分别来自 CodeDoc 和 RepoAgent 各一份）。 三名拥有两年以上 Python 开发经验的研究生在 ISO 八个代表性维度子集上，以 1–5 分制对每个产物进行评分（盲评、随机顺序）。 为评估跨裁判模型家族的稳健性，我们使用 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 在完全相同的评分标准下对同样的 45 对文档进行重新评估。

paragraphs.en: RQ2.a – Quality vs. baselines. Having established that the criteria distinguish quality levels, we compare CodeDoc against two baselines: RepoAgent [ 16 ] , the most directly comparable open-source repository-level documentation generation tool, and a Long-Context baseline that feeds the full source file containing each target entity to the same backbone LLM (GPT-5-mini) under a matched token budget, without documentation criteria or dependency selection. For each repository we generate documentation under both ISO- and GitHub-oriented objectives, and evaluate each generation only under its aligned criteria.

paragraphs.en: RQ3.c – Static dependency recovery audit. Because CodeDoc relies on Pyan3 static call graphs for dependency-aware retrieval, the accuracy of recovered caller–callee edges directly affects the relevance of the injected context. We therefore audit Pyan3’s precision and recall on Flask, NumPy, and PyTorch, which span our repository-scale groups and vary in their use of dynamic Python features. For each repository, we randomly sample 50 functions. Two authors independently annotate each function’s ground-truth callers and callees from the source code, resolving disagreements by discussion. We then compute precision as the fraction of recovered Pyan3 edges that are correct, and recall as the fraction of ground-truth edges that Pyan3 recovers. We also report the share of ground-truth edges involving dynamic features, such as getattr , parameterized decorators, metaclasses, or monkey-patching, since these are especially difficult for static analysis.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3.c – 静态依赖恢复审计。 由于 CodeDoc 依赖 Pyan3 静态调用图进行依赖感知检索，恢复出的调用者—被调用者边的准确性直接影响注入上下文的相关性。 因此，我们在 Flask、NumPy 和 PyTorch 上审计 Pyan3 的精确率和召回率，这三个仓库覆盖了我们的仓库规模分组，并且在动态 Python 特性的使用上各不相同。 对于每个仓库，我们随机抽取 50 个函数。 两名作者独立地从源代码中标注每个函数的真实调用者和被调用者，并通过讨论解决分歧。 然后我们计算精确率为恢复出的 Pyan3 边中正确边的比例，召回率为 Pyan3 恢复出的真实边占全部真实边的比例。 我们还报告了涉及动态特性（如 getattr、参数化装饰器、元类或猴子补丁）的真实边的占比，因为这些对静态分析而言尤其困难。

paragraphs.en: Table IV reports the audit. Precision is uniformly high (86–91%): Pyan3 rarely fabricates dependency edges. Recall is moderate (67–76%), reflecting the inherent limitation of static analysis on dynamic-feature-heavy code. PyTorch exhibits the lowest recall and the highest dynamic-edge proportion (31.5%). paragraphs.en: We organise threats to validity along construct, internal, and external dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们沿着构念、内部和外部三个维度来组织效度威胁。

paragraphs.en: Construct validity. Our evaluation relies on an LLM judge that scores documentation against predefined criteria, raising two concerns: judge reliability and rubric circularity. For reliability, RQ1.a shows that the judge responds consistently to controlled quality degradation, and RQ1.b corroborates it against human scores ( ρ = 0.72 \rho=0.72 , κ = 0.51 \kappa=0.51 ) and across model families. For circularity—the same criteria drive both the generation prompt and the evaluation rubric—we note that the sensitivity test in RQ1.a uses official PyTorch documentation rather than CodeDoc outputs, validating the rubric independently of our method, and that all baselines are scored under the same rubric so any criterion-alignment inflation affects them equally.
paragraphs.zh: 构念效度。 我们的评估依赖于一个 LLM 评判器，它依据预定义标准对文档进行打分，这引发了两个担忧：评判器的可靠性与评分标准的循环性。 关于可靠性，RQ1.a 表明该评判器对受控的质量退化做出一致的响应，并且 RQ1.b 通过人工打分（ρ=0.72，κ=0.51）以及跨模型家族的比较印证了这一点。 关于循环性——即同一套标准既驱动生成提示词又驱动评估评分标准——我们指出，RQ1.a 中的敏感性测试使用的是 PyTorch 官方文档而非 CodeDoc 的输出，从而独立于我们的方法验证了评分标准，并且所有基线方法均在同一评分标准下打分，因此任何由标准对齐带来的虚高会同等影响它们。

The Long-Context baseline isolates the contribution of dependency-aware retrieval from simply providing more code context, but additional baselines (e.g., retrieval-only approaches and other repository-context methods) would further strengthen the comparison. paragraphs.en: Our work combines automatic code documentation generation, repository-level software understanding, and standards-guided evaluation. paragraphs.en: Software documentation is critical for software evolution, maintenance, and developer productivity, yet maintaining high-quality documentation remains challenging, especially in large and rapidly evolving systems [ 4 , 6 , 1 , 11 ] . While documentation quality depends on multiple dimensions, including accuracy, completeness, consistency, readability, and maintainability, these attributes are rarely defined through explicit and actionable criteria. We therefore treat documentation quality as an assessable engineering objective, grounding both generation and evaluation in established documentation standards rather than subjective judgments.
paragraphs.zh: 软件文档对软件演进、维护以及开发者的生产力至关重要，然而保持高质量的文档仍然极具挑战性，尤其是在大型且快速演进的系统中 [ 4 , 6 , 1 , 11 ] 。 尽管文档质量取决于多个维度，包括准确性、完整性、一致性、可读性和可维护性，但这些属性很少通过明确且可操作的标准来定义。 因此，我们将文档质量视为一个可评估的工程目标，将生成与评估都建立在既定的文档标准之上，而非主观判断。

paragraphs.en: Early work on automatic code documentation generation relied on heuristic, template-based, and retrieval-oriented methods, using code stereotypes, method context, structural cues, and mined developer discussions to generate natural-language summaries for functions or code fragments [ 37 , 38 , 18 , 19 , 20 , 23 , 24 , 22 ] . Such approaches are interpretable but typically limited to local contexts, struggling to capture broader repository structure and cross-file dependencies. Neural models subsequently improved summarisation by learning code-to-text mappings [ 25 , 26 , 27 ] , and the emergence of LLMs has enabled zero-shot and few-shot documentation generation with general-purpose LLMs [ 15 , 13 ] . Much of this literature, however, still focuses on method- or snippet-level generation, where the target is relatively local and self-contained.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的自动代码文档生成工作依赖于启发式、基于模板和面向检索的方法，利用代码原型、方法上下文、结构线索以及挖掘的开发者讨论，为函数或代码片段生成自然语言摘要 [ 37 , 38 , 18 , 19 , 20 , 23 , 24 , 22 ] 。 这类方法具有可解释性，但通常局限于局部上下文，难以捕捉更广泛的仓库结构和跨文件依赖。 神经模型随后通过学习代码到文本的映射改进了摘要生成 [ 25 , 26 , 27 ] ，而大语言模型（LLM）的出现使得利用通用大语言模型进行零样本和少样本文档生成成为可能 [ 15 , 13 ] 。 然而，这一领域的文献大多仍聚焦于方法级或片段级的生成，其目标相对局部且自包含。

paragraphs.en: More recent work has moved beyond isolated functions toward repository-level documentation generation, since real repositories exhibit dependencies across files, modules, classes, and functions, and useful documentation often requires reasoning over this broader context. RepoAgent leverages repository structure and inter-file relationships to generate repository-level documentation [ 16 ] , and RepoSummary explores feature-oriented summarisation that emphasises higher-level functional organisation over purely local descriptions [ 14 ] . These systems represent an important step toward practical documentation generation, but they generally define documentation quality implicitly —through prompting strategies, output formats, or high-level user instructions—rather than grounding generation or evaluation in reusable criteria derived from standards or engineering guidelines. In contrast, our work makes documentation criteria first-class: fine-grained criteria are extracted from established standards and used to guide both generation and evaluation. Within the same per-entity scope, we additionally report cost–quality trade-offs and dependency-recovery audits that are typically absent from prior repository-level work.
paragraphs.zh: 更近期的工作已超越孤立函数，转向仓库级文档生成，因为真实仓库存在跨文件、模块、类和函数的依赖关系，而有用的文档往往需要基于这一更广泛的上下文进行推理。 RepoAgent 利用仓库结构和文件间关系来生成仓库级文档 [ 16 ] ，而 RepoSummary 则探索面向特性的摘要生成，强调更高层次的功能组织而非纯粹的局部描述 [ 14 ] 。 这些系统代表了朝着实用文档生成迈出的重要一步，但它们通常通过提示策略、输出格式或高层的用户指令来隐式地定义文档质量，而不是以从标准或工程指南中提炼出的可复用准则作为生成或评估的依据。 与之相反，我们的工作将文档准则提升为一等公民：从既有标准中提取细粒度准则，并用其同时指导生成与评估。 在相同的单实体范围内，我们额外报告了成本—质量权衡与依赖恢复审计，这些内容在以往仓库级工作中通常是缺失的。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation remains a major challenge in automatic documentation generation. Earlier work relied on human judgement or small-scale comparative studies to assess summary usefulness and quality [ 39 ] , while broader software-engineering research emphasises the importance of rigorous and transparent evaluation methodology with careful treatment of datasets, criteria, and metrics [ 7 ] . Recent studies on code understandability similarly argue that meaningful evaluation should go beyond surface-level fluency and assess whether artifacts genuinely improve comprehension and developer usefulness [ 10 , 9 ] . The LLM-as-a-judge paradigm has emerged as a scalable alternative for evaluating generated text, with representative approaches including MT-Bench [ 34 ] , G-Eval [ 35 ] , and JudgeLM [ 40 ] , showing that carefully designed rubrics and prompts can achieve reasonable agreement with human evaluators—a finding that motivates our standards-aligned judge design. In the broader context of repository-level code intelligence, retrieval-augmented approaches such as RepoCoder [ 41 ] and benchmarks such as RepoBench [ 42 ] demonstrate the value of selectively retrieving cross-file context for code completion; our dependency-aware retrieval shares this motivation but targets structurally relevant context for standards-guided documentation generation rather than completion candidates.
paragraphs.zh: 评估仍然是自动文档生成中的一项重大挑战。 早期工作依赖人工判断或小规模对比研究来评估摘要的有用性与质量 [39]，而更广泛的软件工程研究则强调严谨且透明的评估方法的重要性，需要对数据集、标准和指标进行审慎处理 [7]。 关于代码可理解性的近期研究同样指出，有意义的评估不应停留在表层流畅度，而应评估产物是否真正提升了理解程度和对开发者的有用性 [10, 9]。 「以 LLM 为评审者」的范式已成为评估生成文本的一种可扩展的替代方案，代表性方法包括 MT-Bench [34]、G-Eval [35] 和 JudgeLM [40]，它们表明精心设计的评分规则和提示词能够与人类评估者达成合理的一致性——这一发现促成了我们与标准对齐的评审者设计。 在更广泛的仓库级代码智能背景下，RepoCoder [41] 等检索增强方法和 RepoBench [42] 等基准证明了有选择地检索跨文件上下文对代码补全的价值；我们的依赖感知检索与之一脉相承，但面向的是与标准引导的文档生成相关的结构化上下文，而非补全候选。

paragraphs.en: Our work differs from prior evaluation practice in two respects. First, rather than relying solely on unconstrained preference judgements, we construct an explicit rubric of documentation criteria derived from formal and practice-oriented standards. Second, we use this rubric to support criterion-level LLM-based evaluation, enabling repository documentation to be assessed in a structured and reproducible way that aligns documentation generation with broader software-engineering expectations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作在两个方面不同于以往的评估实践。 首先，我们不再仅仅依赖无约束的偏好判断，而是基于形式化和面向实践的标准，构建了一套明确的文档评估准则。 其次，我们利用这套准则支持基于大语言模型（LLM）的准则级评估，使代码仓库文档能够以结构化、可复现的方式进行评估，并使文档生成与更广泛的软件工程期望保持一致。

paragraphs.en: This paper presented CodeDoc , a standards-guided and dependency-aware framework for code-level documentation generation. By aligning the generation target, the static-analysis input, and the evaluation unit on the same per-entity scope, and by extracting fine-grained criteria from formal ISO/IEC/IEEE standards and practice-oriented GitHub references, CodeDoc grounds both generation and evaluation in a single reusable rubric, departing from prior systems that rely on implicit, ad-hoc prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了 CodeDoc，一个以标准为引导、具备依赖感知能力的代码级文档生成框架。 通过将生成目标、静态分析输入和评估单元统一到相同的逐实体范围，并从正式的 ISO/IEC/IEEE 标准和面向实践的 GitHub 参考中提取细粒度准则，CodeDoc 将生成与评估都建立在同一套可复用的评分标准之上，有别于以往依赖隐式、临时提示词的系统。

paragraphs.en: Our experiments show that the standards-derived criteria respond consistently to controlled degradation and that the LLM-based evaluation aligns with human judgement ( ρ = 0.72 \rho=0.72 ) and across judge model families (RQ1); that CodeDoc improves documentation quality over both RepoAgent and a long-context baseline, with significant effect sizes and broad per-category gains (RQ2); and that dependency-aware retrieval and standards-guided prompting contribute complementarily for a more favourable cost–quality trade-off, while static dependency recovery is high-precision but moderate-recall, with completeness correlating positively with downstream quality (RQ3).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实验表明：由标准衍生的准则对受控退化保持一致的响应，且基于大语言模型的评估与人类判断一致（ρ = 0.72 \rho=0.72），并在不同评判模型家族之间保持一致（RQ1）；CodeDoc 在文档质量上优于 RepoAgent 和长上下文基线，效应量显著且在各类别上均有广泛提升（RQ2）；依赖感知检索与标准引导提示以互补方式贡献于更有利的成本—质量权衡，而静态依赖恢复具有高精确率但中等召回率，其完整性与下游质量呈正相关（RQ3）。

paragraphs.en: Future work includes scaling the human evaluation, extending CodeDoc beyond Python, supplementing static analysis with dynamic analysis to close the recall gap, and conducting independent inter-annotator validation of the extracted criteria. We believe the standards-guided perspective offers a useful foundation for documentation systems where quality must be assessed not only by fluency, but also by engineering completeness, practical usefulness, and maintainable organization.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的工作包括扩大人工评估规模、将 CodeDoc 扩展到 Python 之外、以动态分析补充静态分析以缩小召回率差距，以及对提取的标准进行独立的标注者间验证。 我们相信，这种以标准为导向的视角为文档系统提供了有用的基础，在这类系统中，质量的评估不仅要看流畅性，还要看工程完整性、实际有用性和可维护的组织结构。
